CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_version (
  version integer PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  applied_at text NOT NULL DEFAULT [object Object]
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bookmarks (
  id text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  title text NOT NULL,
  url text NOT NULL,
  description text,
  favicon text,
  image text,
  tags text NOT NULL DEFAULT ,
  date_added text NOT NULL DEFAULT [object Object],
  favorite integer NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  collection_id text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inbox',
  liked integer NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  saved integer NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  last_updated_at text NOT NULL DEFAULT [object Object]
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS feeds (
  id text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  title text NOT NULL,
  feed_url text NOT NULL,
  site_url text,
  last_fetched text,
  unread_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_updated_at text NOT NULL DEFAULT [object Object]
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS articles (
  id text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  feed_id text NOT NULL,
  title text NOT NULL,
  link text NOT NULL,
  content_snippet text,
  content text,
  full_content text,
  image_url text,
  image_data text,
  pub_date text,
  read integer NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  liked integer NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  saved integer NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  last_updated_at text NOT NULL DEFAULT [object Object],
  read_at text,
  FOREIGN KEY (feed_id) REFERENCES feeds(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS highlights (
  id text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  article_id text NOT NULL,
  text text NOT NULL,
  color text NOT NULL,
  created_at text NOT NULL DEFAULT [object Object],
  FOREIGN KEY (article_id) REFERENCES articles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS annotations (
  id text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  highlight_id text NOT NULL,
  text text NOT NULL,
  timestamp text NOT NULL DEFAULT [object Object],
  FOREIGN KEY (highlight_id) REFERENCES highlights(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
